brief.summary: Timeless, sultry minimalism: a crisp white shirt or a black body with high-waisted jeans or tailored trousers, a long black coat, a slicked low ponytail, big gold hoops and a red lip. Few pieces, clean lines and strong contrast; the effect is ease and confidence, never trend.
signatures: crisp oversized white shirt tucked into high-waisted jeans or trousers
black fitted bodysuit or fine knit with a wide belt
long black or camel wool coat worn open
black column or slip dress for evening
wide leather belt at the waist
large gold hoop earrings and a gold cuff
